title: Claims Processor
description:
Raventra Health is a medical services company providing outsourced billing, coding, and claims processing solutions for provider groups and hospitals. As a Claims Processor, you will review and process healthcare claims to ensure they are accurate, complete, and submitted according to payer requirements. You will work closely with billing and coding teams to identify discrepancies, resolve routine issues, and help ensure claims are processed efficiently and accurately.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Review and process healthcare claims in accordance with payer requirements and established procedures

• Verify claim information for accuracy, completeness, and consistency before submission

• Apply payer-specific requirements and billing guidelines accurately and consistently

• Identify claims requiring additional documentation, correction, or review and escalate as appropriate

• Resolve routine claim discrepancies and errors within established guidelines

• Work with billing and coding teams to investigate and resolve claim-related issues

• Maintain accurate records of processed claims and follow established documentation procedures

• Meet productivity and quality standards while maintaining a high level of accuracy

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 1+ year of experience in medical claims processing, healthcare billing, or a related revenue cycle role

• Working knowledge of CMS-1500 and UB-04 claim forms

• Understanding of basic medical billing terminology and payer requirements

• Experience with a claims processing, billing, or practice management system

• Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies in claim information

• Ability to manage high-volume work while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines

• Strong communication and problem-solving skills

• HIPAA-compliant private workspace and ability to work effectively in a fully remote role

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience working with multiple insurance payers

• Medical coding knowledge or experience

• Experience with claim corrections, denials, or appeals

• Familiarity with electronic claims submission systems

• Experience working with provider groups or hospitals

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
Compensation will be discussed during the interview and will reflect the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant healthcare revenue cycle expertise.
Benefits and additional employment details will be discussed during the hiring process.
HIRING PROCESS
Application review → introductory conversation → practical assessment → hiring manager interview → offer.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please contact us and we will work with you to provide appropriate support.

The BDR will also conduct quarterly business reviews with sales leadership to evaluate performance to the stated company and territory goals.

Sound Interesting?

Meet or exceed sales growth targets for Direct Rx business and other strategic targets such as premium lenses, coatings, finished single vision lenses and organizational programs and projects.

• Utilize Salesforce.com to identify key customer targets to increase territory sales.

• Profile and evaluate each customer’s store operation, financial data, business model & profit drivers, and create value-based sales strategies that has positive financial impact on company.

• Lead sales conversation with ECPs by challenging and persuading them to change behavior. Build agreement at each point in the sales process, remove barriers and close the deal.

• Create innovative tactical and strategic approaches to meet and exceed business objectives when faced with an obstacle or a customer concern.

• Increase sales by effectively communicating the advantages and benefits of Carl Zeiss Vision products and services to Eye Care Professionals.

• Support and implements national marketing plans, utilizing digital tools and apps.

• Schedule, plan, develop and conduct on-site individual, group and office training and educational seminars to increase demand for Carl Zeiss Vision labs and lenses.

• Work with Alliance Groups to maximize opportunities to grow CZV share within assigned territory.

• Establish a positive, productive and collaborate working relationships with Carl Zeiss Vision employees and colleagues.

• Operate with the highest ethical standard during every customer interaction and in alignment with Carl Zeiss philosophies and leadership principles.

• Input accurate and timely reports via Salesforce.com.

• Efficiently manage travel cost and leverage smart spending techniques.

• Prepare and submit timely expense reports.

description:

Role Summary
BizOps is part of Evercam ’s Systems, Data and AI function. It plays a core role in supporting internal business processes and automation. BizOps primarily implements ERP-type processes across our Zoho Suite of products. It also develops and manages internal software tools that support the business.
The BizOps Senior Systems Engineer turns BizOps ideas, tickets, and cross-functional requests into delivered work. The role includes intake, scoping, project plans, implementation, stakeholder follow-up, rollout communication, documentation, and closure across CRM, Desk, Analytics, Finance, CS, Sales, Product, and Ops workflows.
The role is intentionally broad. It favours candidates who think across systems, data, and integrations. We need someone who can plan and implement systems. We need someone who can document and communicate about those systems to ensure adoption and optimal usage. This person should understand Zoho CRM top to bottom, see how Sales, Marketing, CS, Finance, Analytics, and Ops use the same data differently, and help connect work across the entire lead-to-cash operating model.
Application note: All applicants must complete a short pre-screening assessment as part of the application process to help us better understand your experience and fit for the role - applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.
Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

• Build lightweight project plans with stakeholders across the business.

• Implement required changes across involved systems, using whatever combination of system configuration, low-code/no-code tooling, scripting, and AI-driven custom software development is needed.

• Coordinate QA, rollout, training, and post-launch feedback loops.

Documentation and Adoption

• Maintain GetOutline documentation, project notes, and handoff materials for BizOps workflows.

• Turn repeated questions into better process notes, training material, or workflow improvements.

• Ensure new workflows have clear owners, escalation paths, adoption metrics, and review dates.

• Help teams move away from ad hoc chat requests toward visible ticket and project systems.

Systems, Data and AI

• Understand Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, Desk, Analytics, Zoho Mail, Google Drive, and related integrations well enough to spot ownership gaps, source-of-truth conflicts, and downstream impact before changes are made.

• Use AI to develop required internal custom software tools

• Translate business objectives into clear data model, field, workflow, integration, reporting, and governance requirements.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, CS, Finance, Analytics, Product, and BizOps so systems support how people actually work, not just how tools can be configured.

• Evaluate build-vs-buy options with Antonio or the technical owner, balancing speed, maintainability, data quality, adoption, and ownership.

Requirements

title: Director of Employee Health and Safety
description:
The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early phase site network, fully dedicated to oncology clinical research. To date, over 45 therapies conducted at START locations have obtained FDA/EMA approval.
The START Center for Cancer Research is seeking aDirector of Employee Health and Safety (Remote)who will provide strategic and operational leadership for START's Occupational Health and Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) program across START's clinical operations. This role is accountable for the design, documentation, standardization, implementation, and day-to-day execution of programs that ensure a safe environment for employees, patients, and research activities while maintaining up-to-date compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
The Director ensures adherence to OSHA, USP , NIOSH, drug handling guidance, EPA requirements, and research standards. Given START's focus on oncology clinical research, this role also encompasses compliance touchpoints relevant to investigational product handling, hazardous drug exposure, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and ICH guidelines as they intersect with site safety obligations.
This role establishes and maintains enterprise-wide EHS standards, policies, and procedures governing areas such as drug storage and handling, PPE, fit testing, hazardous material and chemical management, and workplace incident response.
Partnering cross-functionally with Operations/Clinical Leadership, HR, and Compliance, this role translates regulatory and compliance requirements into practical, scalable processes that integrate seamlessly into site operations. The Director will also support select compliance program initiatives under the direction of the Vice President, Compliance and General Counsel, serving as an additional resource for enterprise-wide compliance priorities. The role is responsible for proactive risk identification, incident response, and continuous improvement of safety performance. Success is measured by reduced risk exposure, strong compliance outcomes, and seamless support of business objectives.
This is a remote role. The salary range for this role is $135,000 - $155,000.However, base pay may vary depending on multiple individualized factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm

Health & Safety (EHS) Compliance

• Build and operationalize standardized EHS program across all U.S. sites, ensuring consistency while accommodating state-specific requirements.
